def golden_test(name, src, golden, **kwargs):
    native.genrule(
        name = name + "_actual",
        srcs = [src],
        outs = [name + ".actual"],
        cmd = "$(location //tools:render) $< > $@",
        tools = ["//tools:render"],
        tags = ["manual"],
    )
    native.sh_test(
        name = name,
        srcs = ["//tools:diff_test.sh"],
        args = ["$(location :%s_actual)" % name, "$(location %s)" % golden],
        data = [":" + name + "_actual", golden],
        **kwargs
    )
